comparison.objective: Unhook and remove an air-fryer basket, then place it on a heat-proof mat; candidate separates a mixed charge and returns the screen to its supports.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1814 tests constrained sliding under retaining hooks, handle grasping, lifting, transport, placement, and release. Candidate adds two-tab load sharing and controlled agitation that must pass one object class through apertures while retaining another.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1814 requires the basket on the mat, released with finger clearance, after clearing hooks; earlier versions also cover drawer release and avoiding hot surfaces. Candidate requires at least 98% media recovery for completion credit, all washers retained, no invalid passage or spill, bilateral support, 60 mm clearance, and 3 s stability.
comparison.reason: Generic container lifting and placement are shared, but PR-1814 does not test selective many-body separation or aperture-mediated retention.
